objective: Render a content-rich text-free human-free Polished Tech Explainer diagram with exactly six nodes and six directed edges: intake enters framing, framing enters execution, execution enters verification, verification enters stable result, failed verification enters recovery, and recovery returns only to framing.

confirmed: The primary route is intake to framing to execution to verification to stable result.
Only verification may enter recovery on a failed-check edge.
Recovery returns only to framing, and stable result is reachable only from verification.
simplifications: Use exactly six substantial rounded modules and exactly six visible directed connections; add information-design layers only as blank non-semantic zones.
Use cobalt for the four solid primary edges, amber for the dashed verification-to-recovery failed-check edge, and cool gray-blue for the dashed recovery-to-framing return edge.
Use cobalt or pale-blue styling for intake framing execution and verification, one teal success treatment only inside stable result, and one pale amber treatment only inside recovery.
Place five primary nodes in one horizontal row inside a large rounded white main container and recovery in a smaller pale-amber recovery group below the gap between framing and verification.

Above the containers reserve one blank eyebrow rule, one long blank title bar, and one shorter blank subtitle bar at upper-left; place two large translucent blue-cyan decorative circles at upper-right.

Inside every node include one blank step-index disc, one simple icon, one blank navy title rail, and one blank gray caption rail; these blank shapes are typography placeholders rather than additional nodes.
Add one blank cobalt-to-cyan group pill above the main row and one blank amber group pill above recovery; add one pale-blue blank explanatory strip along the bottom of the main container.
Use no generated glyphs anywhere; all exact wording and step numbers will be added deterministically after topology review.
blocked: Do not add human judgment policy approval deployment monitoring database queue model agent tool notification score metric bypass or any undeclared node edge state group or shortcut.
Do not treat title bars subtitle bars index discs caption rails group pills decorative circles or explanatory strips as semantic nodes and do not connect arrows to them.
Do not copy the cover devices circular hub input-card fan system-panel graph or the concept three-layer glass stack verification core source modules result-card layout.
Do not copy the user's reference labels wording exact topology lane titles orange three-card judgment lane node content or explanatory sentence.

Do not add generated Chinese English words letters numbers pseudo-writing labels legends code UI copy dimensions logos watermarks people hands robots browser chrome phones glass capsules or 3D device perspective.
Do not use dark cyanotype black dashboard neon cyberpunk decorative arrows extra arrowheads topology-obscuring glow or heavy shadows.

invariants: Stable result is reachable only from verification.
Recovery receives only from verification and returns only to framing.
No edge enters intake and no recovery edge reaches execution verification or stable result directly.
